title: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate a single continuous ~30-second shot with zero cuts…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to generate a single continuous ~30-second shot with zero cuts if you want a scroll-controlled “rotating product” website effect.  
Avoid inserting any cuts in the Seedance footage; even one cut breaks the scroll-as-remote-control illusion.  
Generate the Seedance footage first, then build the website/page around that exact video (don’t design the page first).
